import pandas as pd

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
df = pd.read_csv("orders_3m.csv", parse_dates=["datetime"])
days=["пн","вт","ср","чт","пт","сб","вс"]
s=df.groupby(df.datetime.dt.dayofweek).amount.sum().reindex(range(7))
colors=["tab:orange" if x==s.idxmax() else "lightgray" for x in s.index]
fig,ax=plt.subplots()
bars=ax.bar(days,s.values,color=colors)
ax.bar_label(bars)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
d=pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv")

ax.legend()
